pages.text: Vegetables or raw and cooked meat heal it through a "digestion pool" , Nether Wart heals 1 at a time.$(br)A calf has 200 health and grows up after 20 feedings.$(br)$(l)Combo$(): 20 + 20 + 20, the first two apply Busted for 1s.$(br)$(l)Slam$(): 16 damage + heavy knockback in a 6-block radius, and it swats away projectiles in flight; 3s cooldown.

$(l)Relentless charge$(): 15 damage + 4%% of the target's max health, leaving 5 lanes of spikes every 2 ticks (each spikes into the ground for 1s then bursts); 20s cooldown after the move.$(br)$(l)Quill rain$(): 2 quills every 5 ticks, 20 in total, 10 damage each, rising first then diving; a missed quill lands and bursts after 1s (1-block radius, 5 damage).$(br)$(l)Passive$(): anything hit by its melee, slam or charge catches fire for 5s.
